Axiom:
The draft MUST preserve ALL data from `ExtractionResult`: - All `variants[]` are reflected in the Variants table. - All unique `(element, metric)` pairs from all `Measurements` are reflected in Token Mapping. - All `elements[]` are listed in Element Structure. - Every state for every (size, appearance, mode) combination has a BDD scenario.
Missing data (state not in extraction, token not found) → mark explicitly with `⚠️`, never silently omit.
